items.name: Quality Agent
items.headline: RFP specification matching
items.body: The Quality Agent matches customer RFP specifications against your product information sheets in minutes. A two-day review becomes a five-minute task.
points: Instantly compare customer specs against your full product catalog
Surface non-conformities and gaps before they reach the customer
Free senior QC staff from routine document work for higher-value decisions

items.name: Sales Agent
items.headline: Intelligent sales response
items.body: Match inbound customer queries to the right SKUs using your full ERP history, in minutes.
points: Parse unstructured customer emails and extract product requirements
Match queries against full ERP history with confidence scores
Hand off between sales and quality teams without losing context

items.name: Procurement
items.headline: Buy smarter on volatile inputs.
items.body: Live price feeds, demand signals, and forward risk scores on spices, oleoresins, and naturals. Reverse auctions run directly over WhatsApp and email.

items.name: Production
items.headline: Connect demand to the factory floor.
items.body: Shift planning, one shared production plan, and live equipment-effectiveness visibility, so what sales commits and what the plant delivers are finally the same number.

items.name: Formulation
items.headline: Protect your formulation IP.
items.body: Reverse engineer formulations, capture reformulation reasoning, and track samples to commercial conversion. Your flavorists' knowledge stays in the system.

items.name: Market Intelligence
items.headline: Know what's coming before your competition does.
items.body: Trend signals, competitive tracking, and ingredient market shifts, surfaced automatically as a morning briefing instead of a data dump.
